name: cache-watch
description: Shows the prompt cache state above the prompt: warm or cold, time left before it expires, the real cost of the last call, and the cost of a prompt sent with a cold cache. Cache lifetime and price are worked out from real usage, with the options below as fallback

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request: 5m (default) or 1h (subscriptions with the extended cache)

inputPricePerMTok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputPricePerMTok.description: Base input price of the model. 0 = guess from the model name (opus 5, sonnet 3, haiku 1)
